scope: Exact EEGPT checkpoint used by the existing local benchmarks. This is technical provenance and license issue-spotting, not legal certification.

derived_encoder_artifact.rights_note: A local tensor-only extraction from the identified checkpoint; conversion does not create or expand checkpoint reuse permission.

repository_identity.evidence: The 2026-09-19 main-branch commit changes only the two listed pretraining-dataset files; it does not alter the root README, LICENSE, or checkpoint link.

sources_reviewed.finding: The source repository contains Apache License 2.0. The license defines the licensed Work as a work made available under the license as indicated by an included or attached notice. The external checkpoint has no observed attached license notice.

sources_reviewed.evidence_quote: You can download pretrained models here
sources_reviewed.finding: The README names the exact checkpoint inside the linked Figshare share and instructs users to load it for downstream tasks. It does not state that Apache-2.0 covers the checkpoint and supplies no separate model-weight terms.
The share page still returned an AWS WAF challenge (HTTP 202 with an empty body) during this recheck, so no article authorship or license field could be verified.
Existing acquisition provenance ties file ID 46452745 to the exact filename, size, and local SHA-256. Download capability is technical provenance and is not treated as a rights grant.
The latest main revision changes pretraining-dataset preparation only; no new checkpoint license or model card was added.

The Braindecode card declares BSD-3-Clause for its converted 25.3M-parameter, roughly 101 MB artifacts. It is not published by BINE022, is not the exact 1,020,602,524-byte checkpoint, and does not grant rights in the official Figshare checkpoint.

This mirror reports the same SHA-256 as the local official checkpoint. The uploader is not the identified official publisher, so the mirror is useful only as identity corroboration and is not accepted as license authority.

conclusion.reason: Primary sources still identify and encourage use of the checkpoint but do not expressly license the externally hosted weight file. The repository code license, public download access, a third-party converted model card, and another person's byte-identical mirror do not supply the missing affirmative grant for this exact checkpoint.
